topic: Nightly ETL from the app database into a warehouse, handling rows that arrive late or are updated after export.
checker_notes: q7 says "an order created in the last 30 days" without saying when the 30 days are counted from, but the reconciliation window is counted back from the Sunday run, so the order could age out before then and the key's claim that the next Sunday reconciliation catches it would be wrong; reword it as "an order whose creation day is still within the last 30 days when the next Sunday reconciliation runs".
